en.headline: Minibus and truck collide on San Tin Highway, multiple injured
en.dek: A green minibus and a goods vehicle collided near Fairview Park at about 9.24am, with most of the injured reported as lightly hurt and some lanes closed.
body: Police and firefighters attended a collision on San Tin Highway near Fairview Park in Yuen Long at about 9.24am on Monday.

A green minibus and a goods vehicle were involved. Reports indicated that the minibus driver was trapped for a time before being freed. Rescue teams triaged those hurt at the scene, with the majority assessed as having light injuries and a smaller number with more serious injuries.

Different accounts put the number of people injured at least at 11, most of them lightly. The Transport Department said some lanes heading towards Yuen Long near the scene were closed and that traffic was busy. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 新田公路近錦繡花園小巴與貨車相撞 多人受傷
zh.dek: 周一上午約9時24分，元朗新田公路近錦繡花園一輛專線小巴與貨車相撞，大部分傷者輕傷，部分行車線封閉。
body: 警方及消防處接報後，於周一上午約9時24分趕到元朗新田公路近錦繡花園處理交通意外。
意外涉及一輛專線小巴及一輛貨車。據報道，小巴司機一度被困，其後獲救。救援人員在現場為傷者分流，大部分屬輕傷，少數傷勢較重。
不同報道指受傷人數至少11人，以輕傷為主。運輸署表示，往元朗方向近現場的部分行車線已封閉，交通繁忙。警方正調查意外成因。
